name: Baikal-GVD
summary: Expanding deep-water neutrino telescope whose science program includes dark-matter annihilation / decay and other exotic particles.
detection_principle: Independent clusters of optical strings record freshwater Cherenkov light; synchronized clusters reconstruct neutrino tracks and cascades.

sites.name: Deep water in southern Lake Baikal, about 4 km offshore
sites.location: Deep water in southern Lake Baikal, about 4 km offshore

status.label: Partly operating, with further construction continuing
status.evidence: The website lists 16 clusters and about 0.8 km³ in 2026; expansion toward the complete goal continues.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
